redia.definition:
n. A kind of larva, or nurse, which is prroduced within the
   sporocyst of certain trematodes by asexual generation. It in turn
   produces, in the same way, either another generation of rediae, or else
   cercariae within its own body. Called also proscolex, and nurse. See
   Illustration in Appendix.

redias.translation: n. [无脊椎] 雷蚴；[无脊椎] 雷迪幼虫

n. Restoration to a whole or sound state; renewal;
   renovation.
n. Restoration of a mixed body or matter to its former
   nature and state.
n. The law that objects which have been previously
   combined as part of a single mental state tend to recall or suggest one
   another; -- adopted by many philosophers to explain the phenomena of
   the association of ideas.
